title: Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $\alpha$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. translated_title: 超越仿射变换：一种用于逐坐标神经计算的软支配层
translated_abstract: 本文对传统神经网络层中仿射变换的一种替代方案进行了初步研究。在所提出的软支配层中，每个输出单元将输入坐标与一个可学习的参考向量进行比较，并聚合平滑的不等式响应。通过sigmoid松弛使这些比较具有可微性，同时锐度参数 α 控制其向硬阈值决策的过渡。本研究的目的在于考察该原语的可训练性及其直接的阈值解释，而非宣称其可取代仿射层。在单次运行的MNIST实验中，观察到的软支配层最高准确率为：不使用退火时为0.9061，使用退火时为0.9173，而MLP基线为0.9827。这些描述性结果并不能确立可靠的配置排名，也无法在统计上支持退火带来的收益。学习到的参考向量表现出空间结构……
tldr: 本文提出一种软支配层作为仿射变换的替代方案，通过与可学习参考向量进行可微的坐标比较实现逐坐标神经计算，初步实验证明其可训练且具有直接的阈值解释性，但准确率尚低于MLP基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Soft Dominance Layer as an alternative to affine transformations, achieving coordinate-wise neural computation via differentiable comparisons against learnable reference vectors, with preliminary experiments demonstrating its trainability and direct threshold interpretability, though accuracy remains below the MLP baseline.
